title: Unchecked Result/Option unwrap
message: An unchecked unwrap can turn recoverable failure into a runtime panic.

title: Expectation can panic
message: Prefer explicit error propagation or a documented invariant.

title: Explicit panic path
message: An explicit panic is present in executable code.

title: Unfinished implementation marker
message: An unfinished implementation marker remains in the source.

title: Process execution
message: Process execution crosses a trust boundary and must remain sandboxed or explicitly reviewed.

title: Dynamic code evaluation
message: Dynamic evaluation may execute attacker-controlled code.

title: Potential hard-coded credential
message: A credential-looking identifier is assigned in executable source; verify that the value is not hard-coded.

title: Unsafe block or item
message: Unsafe Rust requires a narrow, documented safety invariant.
